messages:
Maria Lopez: FYI — Press coordination sync for DevTool. We have a soft embargo window and a small press list to seed. Need someone to own press sends, CEO quote, and embargo checklist by EOD.
Priya Nair: I can own the press list + media kit. I'll prepare personalized notes for 8 reporters (Tech, infra trade, one podcast) and send at embargo lift.
Samir Patel: I'll prepare the short press copy we can paste into pitches and a simplified 2-line summary for the company Twitter. Also will generate UTMs: utm_source=press, utm_campaign=devtool_launch, utm_medium=article.
Evan Chen: Quick update from eng: final benchmark numbers shifted slightly after late repro runs  median latency down ~25% (not 30%), throughput gains ~1.3x. We should use conservative language and link to the benchmark appendix.
Maria Lopez: Thanks Evan. Priya, please reflect the corrected numbers and note "internal benchmark results" in the press kit.
Priya Nair: Will do. Draft outreach template below for review.
Priya Nair: "Hi {reporter}, hope you're well. We're publishing a DevTool deep-dive that reduces median inference latency by up to 25% and improves throughput in internal tests. Would you like an embargoed copy and a quick call with our lead engineer? Best, Priya / Redwood."
Alex Romero: I'll own distribution mechanics. What embargo time are we using and do we require NDA?
Maria Lopez: Embargo lift: 2026-06-17 17:00:00 UTC (10:00 AM PT). No NDA, but embargo code: EMB-DEVTOOL-0617. Send press kit 24 hours prior to lift.
Samir Patel: Confirmed. I'll slot the outreach sends for 2026-06-16 17:00:00 UTC and add UTMs.
Evan Chen: Product quote request: Maria, can we get a 1-sentence from the product lead or CEO that is press-safe?
Maria Lopez: Use this quote from product: "DevTool helps teams get predictable, production-grade inference without replatforming." Priya, clear for press?
Priya Nair: Good. I'll request a short CEO line for top-tier outlets; otherwise we'll use product quote.
LegalBot: Reminder: any public metric claims must have source link and internal sign-off. Legal sign-off required by 14:00 PT on embargo day.
Maria Lopez: Noted. Evan, ping Legal and Product now and cc Priya.
Evan Chen: Done  Legal + Product pinged.
Priya Nair: Media kit checklist: blog link, benchmark appendix, screenshots, hero image, short bios, exec quote, contact info, embargo code. I'll drop files in /marketing/press/devtool_media_kit/ by tomorrow.
Jena (publish-bot): Note: scheduled publish job set for 2026-06-17 17:00:00 UTC. I will post to #announcements and #company-blog on publish.
Alex Romero: Who will handle journalists who request data or quick dev interviews during the embargo window? Priya or engineering?
Priya Nair: I'll triage initial requests. Evan and one senior eng should be on standby for 30-min interview slots between 09:00-12:00 PT on lift day.
Samir Patel: I'll prepare the tracking sheet for outreach and coverage: shortlinks + UTMs + reporter contact + sent/response/status. We'll use the PR tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/PR-TRACKER (placeholder).
Maria Lopez: Good. Action items recap: Priya  press kit & outreach; Samir  social + UTMs + tracker; Evan  benchmark appendix + chase Legal/Product sign-off; Alex  send ops and embargo logistics; Maria  exec quote follow-up. Flag blockers here.
Priya Nair: Small ask: can we get a high-res headshot of CEO for the kit? Marketing heatmap says yes; Sarah from design will drop it in the folder.
Samir Patel: Also prepping a short internal comm to send to Sales & CS 30 minutes after publish with talking points and trial offer.
Maria Lopez: Perfect. If anyone sees press pick-ups early, post them here. Let's keep tone factual and avoid superlatives until we have sign-off.
Priya Nair: All good  I'll post the embargoed pitch drafts for review in this thread by EOD.
Maria Lopez: Thank you team  smooth execution please. :sparkles:
